key_features: Rooms CRUD with tenant info (Name, Phone, Start Date, Rent Amount, Security Deposit)
Vacant vs Occupied Room Highlighting (Khali rooms banner & badges)
Electricity Meter Readings with auto bill calculation (Current reading - Previous reading * Unit Rate)
Monthly Rent Records with Paid/Pending status toggle
WhatsApp Reminder share links with pre-formatted Hindi+English (Hinglish) message
Quick stats: Total Rent Collected, Pending Amount, Vacant Rooms count, Total Tenants

image_urls.description: Modern apartment building for property header showcase

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust React dashboard in App.js with fully functioning local storage persistence for properties, rooms, tenants, electricity meter readings, and rent ledger.
Use Hinglish labels (e.g. 'Rent Status: Paid / Pending', 'Bijli Bill Calculation', 'Vacant Rooms', 'WhatsApp Reminder Share').
Ensure all interactive elements and buttons include proper data-testid attributes.
Implement gorgeous Tailwind styling, generous spacing, badge indicators for Vacant rooms, and one-click WhatsApp share with customized reminder messages.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use forbidden colors like teal green/teal blue (#1B93A4).
Always ensure high contrast for text over backgrounds.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
